name: Elemental Excelerator
program: Elemental Excelerator project funding (energy, food and agriculture, water)
collect_note: Elemental's own news feed is read twice a day and only posts whose title carries call words (initiative, application, call for, request for, funding opportunity, RFP, apply) are kept as candidate calls. Its funding is open year-round with no listed deadline, so a new initiative or call shows up here as a news post.

sample.title: Elemental Impact Launches the Data Center Innovation Initiative with Amazon, Google, Meta, and Microsoft

evidence: Channels tried 2026-11-16: https://elementalimpact.com/feed/ HTTP 200 application/rss+xml (12 recent posts, news and portfolio stories); sitemap_index.xml HTTP 200 (post, page, company, events, newsletter sitemaps, no calls listing); /wp-json/wp/v2/types HTTP 401 (REST locked); funding-opportunities page HTTP 200 static HTML with one rolling application (Apply Now -> /funding-opportunities/apply/) and no listing or dated deadline, so mode cycle would return zero items; endpoint_recon --no-chrome found no opportunity endpoint. Filter replay: matches the title of the last known call (Data Center Innovation Initiative launch).
